name: legal_db_init
description: One-shot: creates the dossiers/delais/pieces SQLite tables if they do not exist yet. Run once manually after install, then never again (idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS).

parameters.sql_query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dossiers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, client TEXT NOT NULL, type_affaire TEXT, statut TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'actif', date_ouverture TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (date('now')), derniere_activite TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (date('now')))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS delais (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, dossier_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES dossiers(id), type_acte TEXT NOT NULL, date_declenchement TEXT, duree_legale TEXT, date_butoir TEXT NOT NULL, statut TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'actif', confirme_par_avocate INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_delais_butoir ON delais (date_butoir, statut)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pieces (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, dossier_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES dossiers(id), chemin_filestore TEXT NOT NULL, nom TEXT NOT NULL, date_ajout TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (date('now')))
